en.headline: Police arrest three over Tseung Kwan O wounding possibly linked to illicit fuel
en.dek: The three men, aged 16 to 19 and with suspected triad backgrounds, were arrested after a 35-year-old driver was stabbed last week at the industrial estate.
body: Police have arrested three men for allegedly conspiring to wound with intent in a case that may be connected to illicit fuel activity in Tseung Kwan O.

Officers were alerted early last Thursday by staff at Tseung Kwan O Hospital after a 35-year-old light-goods-vehicle driver sought treatment for knife wounds. Inspector Fong Miu-kwan said preliminary inquiries showed he was attacked on Chun Yat Street in the Tseung Kwan O Industrial Estate on the evening of 21 October. About 120 litres of suspected illicit fuel were later found in his vehicle.

The three suspects, aged 16 to 19 and reported to have triad backgrounds, were unemployed. Two have been charged with conspiracy to wound with intent and appeared in court on Monday; the third remains in custody pending charges. Police said the industrial estate has a history of illicit fuel activity and have not ruled out a dispute over such transactions as the motive.

In a separate operation on Monday, officers and firefighters seized about 750 litres of suspected illicit diesel from a medium goods vehicle in the same area. A 25-year-old driver is under investigation for illegal fuel storage.

zh.headline: 將軍澳工業區傷人案 警拘三名涉三合會背景青年
zh.dek: 三名16至19歲男子涉嫌串謀意圖傷人被捕，事主為35歲輕型貨車司機，上周三在駿日街遭襲，車上檢獲約120公升懷疑私油。
body: 警方調查上月21日在將軍澳工業區發生的意圖傷人案，拘捕三名男子，不排除與非法燃油利益糾紛有關。
警方表示，本月22日凌晨接獲將軍澳醫院通報，一名35歲男子自行求醫，身上有多處刀傷。初步調查顯示，事主於21日晚上駕駛輕型貨車停泊在駿日街時遭持刀襲擊。事主經手術後情況穩定。人員其後在其車上檢獲約120公升懷疑未完稅燃油。
三名被捕者年齡介乎16至19歲，報稱無業，均有三合會背景。其中兩人已被暫控串謀意圖傷人罪，昨日提堂；另一人仍被扣查。督察方妙君表示，將軍澳工業區過往有非法燃油活動，警方不排除案件與相關利益糾紛有關。
警方昨日與消防處採取行動打擊區內非法燃油活動，截查一輚中型貨車，檢獲約750公升懷疑未完稅柴油，一名25歲司機涉嫌非法儲存燃油，案件已轉交消防處調查。
